topic: Belgium data comparison and next steps
summary_markdown: The discussion covered the status of upcoming releases and a specific update regarding Belgium data. Regarding releases, [p2] inquired about confirmation from OO, AFA, and DataCorp. [p3] confirmed receiving confirmation from AFA. Separately, [p1] provided an observation on the analytics platform: the decrease in data seen on `analytics.allunite.com` was less pronounced compared to `staging-analytics.allunite.com`. This difference may be due to varying factors applied (e.g., city category vs. malls). [p1] stated they would check this observation with Alexey. Finally, the group agreed to wait for further feedback from a corporate source in France.
decisions: Wait for further feedback from the corporate team in France.
action_items: [p1] will check the data discrepancy between staging and production analytics environments with Alexey.
